reference_rules.denormal_inputs: a denormal operand reads as a signed zero (txfma_f0.v opa/opb/opc_ndn*: fraction cleared when the exponent is 0)
reference_rules.denormal_results: a result below the smallest normal is flushed to a signed zero (DAZ/FTZ, checked here against the unit's own rule)
reference_rules.nan: any NaN input or invalid operation gives the default NaN 0x7FC00000
